pages.title: Sound Clash – Guess the Song Music Trivia Party Game
pages.description: Free guess-the-song party game: the host plays the music, teams buzz in from their phones to name the title and artist. Hebrew & English hits, no app, no sign-up.
pages.ogDescription: Real-time multiplayer music trivia. Buzz in, name the tune, win the round.

pages.title: How to Play Sound Clash – Rules, Scoring & Setup
pages.description: Set up in two minutes: the host picks genres, teams join with a 6-letter code and buzz in to name the song (+10) and the artist (+5). Wrong buzz −3. Full rules and FAQ.

pages.title: Privacy – Sound Clash
pages.description: What Sound Clash stores while you play, for how long, and which services see it. No accounts, no cookies of its own, and Sound Clash shows no ads.

pages.title: Guess the Song with Friends – Group Music Game | Sound Clash
pages.description: Guess the song with friends in one room: teams buzz in from their phones, a host judges, and the TV keeps score. Free, in the browser, no app or sign-up.

pages.title: Music Trivia Buzzer Game – Phones as Buzzers | Sound Clash
pages.description: A music trivia buzzer game with no hardware: each team's phone is its buzzer, the first buzz locks the rest out, and the TV shows the score. Free, no app.

pages.title: How to Host a Music Trivia Night – Free Guide | Sound Clash
pages.description: A host's guide to a music trivia night: speaker and room setup, picking genres and decades, pacing, bonus questions and ties. Free, in the browser, no app.

pages.title: Movie Soundtrack Quiz – Name the Film | Sound Clash
pages.description: Movie soundtrack quiz rounds: a song plays, teams buzz in from their phones and name the film, TV show or musical for 15 points. Disney, TV themes, Hebrew too.

pages.title: Kahoot! Music Quiz Alternative – Real Songs | Sound Clash
pages.description: Want a music round where teams hear the song and buzz in? Sound Clash is a free Kahoot! music quiz alternative: no questions to write, no app, no sign-up.

pages.title: Hitster Alternative – Free, No Cards Needed | Sound Clash
pages.description: A free Hitster alternative in the browser, with no cards and no Spotify: the host plays songs and teams buzz from their phones to name the title and artist.

pages.title: Join a Game – Sound Clash
pages.description: Join a Sound Clash music trivia game from your phone: type the 6-letter code shown on the TV and your phone becomes your team's buzzer.

pages.title: Host a Game – Sound Clash
pages.description: Start a Sound Clash music trivia game in seconds: pick genres and decades, get a join code for the room, and run every round from your phone. Free, no sign-up.

pages.title: Display Screen – Sound Clash
pages.description: Put Sound Clash on the big screen: enter the game code to show the join QR code, the live scoreboard and every song reveal to the whole room.
